stories.h: "Don't buy Christmas clothes for your children without first paying your tithe!" Pastor David Ibiyeomie sparks debate
stories.p: Pastor David Ibiyeomie has reportedly advised parents to pay their tithes before spending money on Christmas clothes for their children. The comment has sparked debate about church priorities, with critics asking whether tithing should come before the basic needs and happiness of struggling families.
body: Pastor David Ibiyeomie has reportedly advised parents to prioritise paying their tithes before spending money on Christmas clothes for their children.
But this raises a serious question about the priorities being preached in some churches today.

Imagine a struggling father or mother who has worked tirelessly throughout the year, trying to put food on the table, pay school fees and provide a little Christmas happiness for their children. Should such a parent feel guilty for buying their children new clothes because they have not paid their tithe?
Tithing is an important religious practice for many Christians, but should it come before the basic needs and happiness of one's children?
Critics are asking: since when did buying Christmas clothes for your own children become something you must first seek financial clearance from the church to do?
stories.alt: Pastor David Ibiyeomie smiling in a navy suit and patterned tie against a grey background
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: Makinde's 2027 presidential bid is a 'water-testing' move rather than a serious push to win, analyst says
stories.p: An analyst has reportedly described Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde's presidential ambition as an exploratory move rather than a bid built to win. The comment adds to the debate over who can challenge for the presidency as campaigns by the APC, NDC and ADC get under way.
more: The analysis is one of several on how the 2027 field is shaping up.
Supporters of the governor have not been quoted in the report.

stories.h: Nkechi Blessing says nobody supported her when she was down as she finds her spark again
stories.p: Nollywood actress Nkechi Blessing has reportedly said she is rediscovering herself after a period of low energy and low confidence. She is said to have noted that few people stood by her during the difficult time.
more: Fans have reportedly sent messages of encouragement online.
She did not name anyone in the remarks reported.

stories.h: Anita Joseph reportedly replies to Sarah Martins' comment about her ended marriage: 'Life is a phase'
stories.p: Actress Anita Joseph has reportedly reacted to a remark by fellow actress Sarah Martins about her failed marriage, saying life is a phase. The exchange has drawn comments from fans online.
more: Fans are split over the exchange between the two actresses.
Neither has said more publicly.

stories.h: Joke Jigan reportedly asks where the 'Lagos baddies' were at Zlatan Ibile's wedding
stories.p: Content creator Joke Jigan has reportedly drawn reactions after pointing out the absence of well-known Lagos socialites at Zlatan Ibile's wedding. The remark adds to the ongoing talk about who attended the star-studded event.
more: The wedding has dominated entertainment conversation since the weekend.
Several guests have shared their own clips and photos from the event.

stories.h: Rapper Ms Jorji says women are transactional in relationships, and her remarks draw reactions
stories.p: Rapper Ms Jorji has reportedly sparked debate after saying that women are transactional in relationships. Nigerians online have responded with mixed views.
more: Some users agreed with her while others pushed back.
She is among the rappers frequently in the spotlight for outspoken comments.

stories.h: Jaymie reportedly criticises Opeyemi over comments about Igbos, saying 'your tribe has failed this country'
stories.p: Social media user Jaymie has reportedly hit back at Opeyemi over remarks about the Igbo people that she described as tribalistic. The exchange comes amid heated online debate about ethnicity and the 2027 elections.
more: The row follows other recent online arguments over tribe and voting.
Many users have called for calm in the debate.

stories.h: Lekki Street Boy shows off the huge amount of money he made at Zlatan's wedding!
stories.p: Social media personality Lekki Street Boy has got people talking after showing off the cash he reportedly received from wealthy guests and celebrities at Zlatan's lavish wedding. He thanked Soso Soberekon, Cubana Chief Priest and others who sprayed and handed him money during the celebration.
body: Popular social media personality Lekki Street Boy has got people talking after showing off the money he reportedly received from wealthy guests and celebrities at Zlatan's lavish wedding celebration.
The excited young man could barely contain his happiness as he displayed the cash and expressed his appreciation to those who showed him love at the event.

He gave special thanks to popular entertainment personality Soso Soberekon, celebrity businessman Cubana Chief Priest, and several others who generously sprayed and handed him money during the celebration.
From the look of things, Lekki Street Boy did not just attend Zlatan's wedding to celebrate with the couple. He also returned home with what appears to be a serious financial blessing.
While some people attended the wedding to enjoy the food, music and celebrity atmosphere, this young man apparently had another reason to remember the occasion.
stories.alt: Lekki Street Boy holds bundles of dollar notes, with inset photos of two of the celebrities he thanked
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: Jubilation in Brazil as Lula supporters pour onto the streets to celebrate election victory
stories.p: Supporters of Brazil's Workers' Party (PT) flooded the streets and set off fireworks to celebrate President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's narrow runoff win over Flávio Bolsonaro of the Liberal Party (PL). Lula took about 51.8% of the vote after the full count, winning a fourth term in one of the most fiercely contested races in the country's recent history.
more: Huge crowds dressed in the party's red filled one of São Paulo's main avenues late into the night.
Lula came from behind after trailing Bolsonaro in the first round.
His new term begins in January 2027.
stories.alt: Aerial view of a huge crowd in red filling a wide city avenue at night, with an inset photo of Lula in the presidential sash giving a thumbs-up
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: Late gospel singer ToluwaniSings: her family reportedly stands firm on burial plans as her father appeals to his daughter-in-law
stories.p: The family of the late gospel singer is said to be insisting on its burial arrangements and demanding a full investigation into her death. Her father has reportedly appealed to his daughter-in-law to reconsider burying him at home rather than in a cemetery.
more: The family is reportedly calling for a thorough investigation.
Reactions are pouring in from fans of the singer online.

stories.h: VeryDarkMan reportedly praises Tinubu's political strategy and says rivals including Peter Obi lack his nerve
stories.p: Social commentator VeryDarkMan has reportedly said President Tinubu's political approach is stronger than that of his rivals, naming Peter Obi among them. The remark is drawing mixed reactions from supporters of different camps ahead of 2027.
more: Supporters of the NDC and the APC are trading views on social media.
The 2027 race is already heating up online.
stories.credit: Photo: Nosa Asemota / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: Bruno Fernandes reportedly likes a cryptic post that appears to criticise Manchester United manager Michael Carrick
stories.p: The Manchester United captain is said to have liked an Instagram post that seems to take aim at manager Michael Carrick after he was dropped. The club has not commented.
more: Fans are debating whether the like was deliberate.
United have been under pressure over recent team selections.
stories.credit: Photo: Bryan Berlin / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: Mr Eazi says he has never paid Shatta Wale, yet the Ghanaian star always turns up at his shows
stories.p: Mr Eazi has reportedly spoken about his friendship with Shatta Wale, saying the dancehall star shows up at his concerts without being paid.
more: The two Afrobeats and dancehall stars have long supported each other's shows.
stories.credit: Photo: NdaniTV / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 3.0

stories.h: Pastor David Ibiyeomie reportedly urges Christians to pay tithes before buying Christmas clothes
stories.p: The Port Harcourt-based pastor is said to have told worshippers to settle their tithes before holiday shopping. His message is drawing mixed reactions online.
more: Nigerians are debating the message as festive spending approaches.

stories.h: US court reportedly sets three dates to reopen the 2027 green card lottery for foreign applicants
stories.p: A US court has reportedly set dates for the reopening of the 2027 diversity visa lottery, news that is drawing strong interest among Nigerians hoping to relocate.
more: Applicants are advised to follow official US government channels only.

stories.h: Love in the courtroom! El-Rufai shares a kiss with his wife as they reunite amid his legal troubles
stories.p: Former Kaduna State Governor Nasir El-Rufai has attracted attention for a tender moment with his wife during a court appearance, sharing a kiss as the couple reunited. The moment comes amid his ongoing legal dispute with the ICPC, which has included allegations that his wife and son were denied access to him while he was in custody.
body: Despite the serious legal battle surrounding him, former Kaduna State Governor Nasir El-Rufai has attracted attention for a tender moment with his wife during a court appearance.

The couple's affectionate reunion has added a personal dimension to the former governor's legal troubles, reminding Nigerians that behind the political controversies and courtroom proceedings, there is also a family dealing with the situation.

El-Rufai has been involved in a legal dispute with the Independent Corrupt Practices and Other Related Offences Commission (ICPC), including allegations that his wife and son were denied access to him while he was in custody.
Whatever anyone thinks about El-Rufai politically, seeing a husband and wife show affection during such a difficult period is bound to attract reactions.
stories.alt: Nasir El-Rufai, in a cream jacket, kisses his wife, who wears a cream headscarf and pink floral dress, in a wood-panelled courtroom
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: Chris Brown reportedly given a suspended eight-month prison sentence over a 2023 nightclub brawl
stories.p: A UK court has reportedly handed the singer a suspended eight-month sentence after he pleaded guilty to a public order offence linked to a brawl at a London nightclub in 2023. Being suspended, the term is not served unless conditions are breached.
more: The case dates back to an incident at a London nightclub in 2023.
The singer had pleaded guilty to a public order offence.
stories.alt: Chris Brown in a black cap, resting his chin on his hand
stories.credit: Image: Chris Brown / social media

stories.h: Eric Bauza, the voice of Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck, dies at 46
stories.p: The Emmy-winning voice actor, best known for voicing Looney Tunes characters such as Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck, has died at the age of 46, according to reports. Tributes from fans and colleagues are circulating online.
more: He took over several classic Looney Tunes roles in recent years.
Fans are sharing clips of his best-loved performances.

stories.h: Peller reacts as King Ochacho says he gave Carter Efe N5 million after his win
stories.p: Streamer Peller has reportedly reacted with displeasure after King Ochacho claimed he handed Carter Efe N5 million following a win. The exchange has drawn comments from fans of the online personalities.
more: Ochacho made the claim after Carter Efe's win.
Peller's response has split fans online.

stories.h: Nigerians pray for Don Jazzy as he reportedly gives out millions amid extreme weather
stories.p: Music executive Don Jazzy has reportedly shared millions of naira with followers as extreme weather linked to El Niño hits parts of the country. Fans have flooded his page with prayers and thanks.
more: The gesture comes amid concern over severe weather conditions.
Fans have praised his giving on social media.
stories.credit: Photo: Unknown author / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 4.0

stories.h: JAMB results of APC national secretary spark reactions online
stories.p: Reported JAMB results said to belong to the APC national secretary have been trending, with Nigerians posting a mix of jokes and comments. The party has not been reported to have issued a statement on the matter.
more: The trending results come as the 2027 campaign season heats up.
Social media users have been sharing screenshots and reacting.

stories.h: Wike's son's response to a cameraman at Zlatan Ibile's wedding draws reactions
stories.p: A clip from Zlatan Ibile's wedding reportedly shows the son of FCT Minister Nyesom Wike reacting after a cameraman pointed a lens at him. The moment has prompted mixed reactions online.
more: The wedding has produced a string of viral moments.
Viewers are split over how he responded.

stories.h: Pantami vows to expose those behind an alleged plot to end his Gombe governorship bid
stories.p: Former minister Isa Ali Pantami has reportedly vowed to expose people he says are plotting to end his Gombe governorship ambition. The statement follows the ongoing INEC review of his candidacy.
more: INEC is reportedly deciding on the candidacy question.
He did not name those he accuses, according to the reports.

stories.h: Nobel laureate María Corina Machado returns to Venezuela after 10 months in exile
stories.p: Venezuelan opposition leader and Nobel Peace Prize winner María Corina Machado is back in Caracas, where supporters gathered to welcome her. She had spent about ten months outside the country.
more: Supporters reportedly greeted her on arrival in the capital.
Her next political steps have not been spelled out.
stories.credit: Photo: SantanaZ / Wikimedia Commons, CC0

stories.h: Peter Obi demands release of supporter reportedly arrested in Lagos
stories.p: Peter Obi has called for the release of a supporter, Rilwan Olawale, who was reportedly arrested in Lagos. Obi urged the authorities to free him without delay. No official reason for the arrest has been made public.
more: Obi's supporters have taken the call to social media.
Police have not yet commented publicly.
stories.credit: Photo: Plus TV Africa / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 3.0

stories.h: Blessing CEO says she does not smoke, drink or party, responding to drug rumours after her release
stories.p: Relationship therapist Blessing CEO has reportedly responded to online claims about drug use following her release from custody. She said she does not smoke, drink alcohol or go to parties.
more: Her release has drawn wide reaction online.
Several public figures have commented on the case.

stories.h: Asake leaves Paris arena hand in hand with his mother after final tour show
stories.p: A clip of Asake walking out of Paris' Accor Arena holding his mother's hand after the last show of his tour is trending. Fans have praised the moment.
more: The Paris date closed the tour.
Fans flooded social media with reactions to the clip.
stories.credit: Photo: Mensah Memories / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 3.0

stories.h: Veteran Yoruba actor Tombolo reportedly appeals for help as he rides okada to survive
stories.p: Veteran Yoruba actor Tombolo has reportedly asked the public for support after turning to motorcycle taxi work to earn a living. The appeal has prompted sympathy from fans.
more: Fans have asked colleagues in the industry to step in.
He is said to be a long-serving Nollywood face.

stories.h: Rudeboy says AI songs are 'too perfect' and easy to identify
stories.p: Singer Rudeboy has spoken out against AI-generated music, saying it sounds too polished and that he can easily tell it apart from human-made songs.
more: The comment comes amid his public feud with his brother Peter.
Debate over AI music in Nigeria continues.
stories.credit: Photo: Accelerate TV / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: Nicki Minaj draws mixed reactions after showing off Air Force One's interior
stories.p: Rapper Nicki Minaj has sparked reactions online after posting images of the interior of the US presidential jet, Air Force One. Fans and critics are split over the post.
more: Her recent comments about Donald Trump have been widely discussed.
The post went viral within hours.
stories.alt: Nicki Minaj filming inside the cabin of Air Force One
stories.credit: Image: @NICKIMINAJ / X

stories.h: Sowore says Nigeria needs leaders whose health conditions are verifiable
stories.p: Activist and politician Omoyele Sowore has said Nigeria needs leaders whose health status can be independently verified. He made the remark amid continuing public discussion about leaders' fitness ahead of 2027.
more: The comment drew mixed responses online.
The presidency has not responded to the remark.
stories.credit: Photo: Mohamed Nanabhay from Qatar / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Nine people reportedly arrested in Nigeria in a US-linked cybercrime probe, with 53 devices seized
stories.p: Nine suspects have reportedly been detained in Nigeria over an international cybercrime investigation said to involve US agents. Dozens of phones and computers were reportedly taken for examination. The suspects are said to have targeted victims in the United States.
more: The 53 seized devices are said to be undergoing forensic checks.
No formal charges have been publicly confirmed yet.

stories.h: Court reportedly issues fresh order to Nasir El-Rufai in the DSS phone-interception case
stories.p: A court has reportedly issued an order to former Kaduna governor Nasir El-Rufai in the case brought against him by the DSS, which centres on remarks he made in a television interview about intercepted calls. The matter was listed for a ruling on his no-case submission.
more: He was granted N100 million bail in May.
His lawyers argue the prosecution has not shown enough evidence for him to defend himself.
stories.credit: Photo: VOA / Wikimedia Commons, Public domain

stories.h: BBNaija's Mercedes reportedly appeals to Don Jazzy for financial help
stories.p: Former Big Brother Naija housemate Mercedes has reportedly said she has been struggling financially since leaving the house and asked music boss Don Jazzy for help. She was the second housemate evicted from the Show Ya Self edition in August.
more: She previously said she hoped to raise money for her father's leg treatment.
Don Jazzy has not publicly responded yet.
stories.credit: Photo: Unknown author / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 4.0

stories.h: IVD reportedly breaks silence after Blessing CEO's release, with a pointed message to critics
stories.p: Relationship content creator IVD has reportedly reacted publicly following the release of Blessing CEO, sending a bold message to those who criticised them. Online reactions have been mixed.
more: The pair have been in the public eye for years over a long-running legal dispute.
Blessing CEO has said charges against IVD were dropped in December 2025.

stories.h: Dembélé and other PSG players reportedly to skip the 2026 Ballon d'Or ceremony despite 10 nominations
stories.p: Several Paris Saint-Germain players are reportedly set to stay away from the Ballon d'Or ceremony even though the club has ten nominees. Ousmane Dembélé is among those named.
more: The club's fixtures are said to be behind the absences.
Kylian Mbappé's Clasico double has also stirred talk around this year's award.
stories.alt: Ousmane Dembélé in a France shirt
stories.credit: Photo: Антон Зайцев / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0

stories.h: They mocked VeryDarkMan over two cars, but 8 months later, look at what he has done!
stories.p: Eight months after critics mocked VeryDarkMan for importing a container with just two cars, the activist and influencer says he has brought in his second 40-foot container from China. This time he has reportedly moved beyond cars into gadgets and portable power stations, sold as Ratel Power Stations.
body: Remember when VeryDarkMan imported his first container of cars and people started dragging him?
Some mocked him, insulted him and questioned his business ambitions. They asked, "Is this the container he has been bragging about? Just two cars?"
Well, barely eight months later, VDM is back with what he says is his second 40-foot container from China!
This time, he has reportedly moved beyond cars into gadgets and portable power stations, which he calls Ratel Power Stations.
According to him, his business goal is simple: make life easier for Nigerians while making good money for himself in the process.
Clearly, he understands that business is business! Nobody starts at the top, and every successful business has to begin somewhere.
Whether you like VeryDarkMan or not, there is nothing wrong with acknowledging someone's business progress.
Congratulations to VDM on this latest venture!
stories.alt: Four photos of VeryDarkMan unloading boxes of Ratel Power Station lithium batteries from a shipping container, and posing in traditional attire beside a new SUV
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: Calls for DSS and police probe after video allegedly shows uniformed youths chanting threats against Christians in Enugu and Jos
stories.p: A viral video, now reported by several Nigerian news outlets, allegedly shows a drill leader and uniformed young men chanting in Hausa for AK-47 rifles to attack Sunday worshippers in Enugu and Jos. An aide to the FCT Minister has asked the DSS and police to investigate. The speaker's identity, the group's affiliation and the translation have not been independently verified.
body: A disturbing video reportedly filmed somewhere in Northern Nigeria has raised serious concerns over alleged threats of religious violence, and is now being reported by several Nigerian news outlets.

The footage shows young men in brown uniforms and blue berets marching and chanting in Hausa during what appears to be a drill. News reports have linked the uniforms to the first-aid volunteer wing of the Islamic movement JIBWIS, whose members help coordinate Friday Jumu'ah prayers.

According to a Hausa-to-English translation circulating with the video, the drill leader allegedly calls for AK-47 rifles so the group can travel to Enugu and attack Christians during Sunday worship. He reportedly refers to the worshippers as "infidels", imitates the sound of gunfire, and also mentions Jos as another target.
Lere Olayinka, media aide to the FCT Minister, has called on the DSS and the police to investigate the video.

However, the location, date, identity of the speaker, the group's actual affiliation and the accuracy of the translation have not been independently verified. No response from the group had been reported at the time of writing.
If the translation is accurate, this is an extremely serious matter. Nobody should be allowed to use religion as an excuse to threaten innocent people, whether they are Christians or Muslims.

If someone openly calls for weapons to attack people during worship, shouldn't that be enough to trigger an immediate security investigation? Nigeria has suffered enough religious violence, and credible threats against worshippers cannot be treated as ordinary speech.
stories.alt: Two stills from the viral video: a young man in a blue beret and brown uniform chants as others march behind him
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: "God told us to take another wife!" American pastor and prophetess introduce second wife to their congregation
stories.p: A married American pastor and prophetess have reportedly introduced another woman, said to be a member of their church, as their new wife, telling the congregation the arrangement was the will of God. The announcement has sparked debate about religious leadership, marriage and the use of divine authority to justify personal decisions.
body: A married American pastor and prophetess have sparked controversy after reportedly introducing another woman, said to be a member of their church, as their new wife.
According to the circulating account, the couple announced to their congregation that they had entered a polygynous marriage, claiming the arrangement was the will of God.
The announcement has raised serious questions about religious leadership, marriage and the use of divine authority to justify personal decisions.
One question many people are asking is whether a religious leader's claim that God approved something should automatically place that decision beyond criticism.
At what point do we begin to distinguish personal desires from what religious leaders describe as God's instructions?
And to Christians who believe marriage should be between one man and one woman, how would you respond if your pastor stood before the congregation and made this announcement?
stories.alt: Three photos of a church stage: a woman in a green dress speaks into a microphone beside a man in a white jacket, and in the last photo a second woman stands with them
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: Burna Boy headlines halftime at the NFL's first regular-season game in Paris
stories.p: Burna Boy performed at halftime of the Steelers and Saints game at the Stade de France, the first regular-season NFL game staged in Paris. The show follows his 2025 headline night at the same stadium, when he became the first African artist to do so.
more: The league announced him as the Paris halftime act in September.
It was one of seven halftime shows across this season's international games.
Ayra Starr is billed for the London game.
stories.credit: Photo: Nuță Lucian from Cluj-Napoca, Romania / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: Kelechi Iheanacho reportedly sets a Turkish league record in Bursaspor win, sends message to Eric Chelle
stories.p: Kelechi Iheanacho is said to have broken a record in the Turkish league during Bursaspor's latest win. He also reportedly sent a message to Super Eagles coach Eric Chelle, in an apparent bid for a national team recall.
more: The striker has been out of the Super Eagles picture recently.
Reaction online has been split between praise and calls for a recall.
stories.credit: Photo: Антон Зайцев / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0

stories.h: Rudeboy reportedly responds to claims he was a dancer amid the P-Square feud
stories.p: Rudeboy has reportedly addressed claims that he started out as a dancer, as the dispute with his brother continues to play out in public. He is said to have given his own account of his early career.
more: The brothers' split has drawn comment from fans and fellow artists.
stories.credit: Photo: Accelerate TV / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: Family of late actor Steve Echendu releases burial plan as Clarion Chukwura pays tribute
stories.p: The family of the late Nollywood actor Steve Echendu has reportedly released a three-day funeral programme for November. Veteran actress Clarion Chukwura is among colleagues who have paid tribute to him.
more: Tributes from the film industry have continued to come in.

stories.h: Two kidnapped children in Rivers reunited with their family
stories.p: Two siblings abducted from their home in Bonny, Rivers State, have reportedly been freed and returned to their parents. A video of the reunion is circulating online.
more: Police have not yet said whether arrests have been made.

stories.h: Davido's aide Dre appeals for return of phone allegedly lost at Zlatan's wedding, offers reward
stories.p: Davido's aide, Dre, has reportedly appealed to whoever took his phone at Zlatan Ibile's wedding to return it, and is said to be offering a cash reward.
more: The wedding has produced a steady stream of viral clips.

stories.h: Ebola patient evacuated from Nigeria on a medical flight as 53 contacts are isolated
stories.p: A 42-year-old woman infected with the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola has reportedly been flown out of Abuja for treatment abroad. She is said to be married to a Swiss diplomat. Officials have identified 53 people who had contact with her and placed them in isolation.
more: The Bundibugyo strain was first recorded in a 2007 outbreak in Uganda.
The NCDC has urged the public to rely on official updates.
Contacts under monitoring are due weekly allowances, the agency has said.

stories.h: Tinubu names Festus Keyamo to head air mobilisation for his 2027 campaign
stories.p: President Tinubu has appointed Aviation Minister Festus Keyamo to lead the Directorate of Air Mobilisation in the APC presidential campaign council, according to a statement from his media adviser. The FAAN managing director, Olubunmi Kuku, is named a deputy director. The directorate will handle air travel and logistics across the six geopolitical zones.
more: Engr. Farouk Ahmed Umar is the second deputy director.
The APC flagged off its re-election campaign in Kaduna over the weekend.
The NDC has also named its own campaign council.
stories.credit: Photo: Kaizenify / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: CCB reportedly reviewing overseas-asset claims against Peter Obi, Bukola Saraki and David Mark
stories.p: The Code of Conduct Bureau is reportedly reviewing claims from the Panama and Pandora Papers leaks about undisclosed foreign assets linked to several current and former politicians, including Peter Obi, Bukola Saraki and David Mark. The bureau is said to have described the process as confidential. Being under review does not mean any wrongdoing has been proven.
more: Others named in the reports include Stella Oduah and James Ibori.
The bureau has declined to give details.
The reports come about 80 days before the election.

stories.h: AY apologises after chaos at his Cardiff comedy show, blames a payment dispute
stories.p: Comedian AY has apologised to fans after his Cardiff show on the UK tour descended into confusion, with ticket holders waiting for hours and police attending. He says he and the other comedians arrived but could not perform because of a payment dispute with the organisers. He has urged the tour management to publish refund details.
more: The dispute was reportedly settled only after most of the crowd had left.
The organisers had not issued a public statement at the time of reporting.

stories.h: Mbappé scores twice as Real Madrid beat Barcelona 2-1 at Camp Nou
stories.p: Kylian Mbappé scored a late winner in the 87th minute to complete a brace and give Real Madrid a 2-1 win at Camp Nou. It ended Barcelona's winning run and was Madrid's first league win at the ground since 2021. Mbappé has now scored eight goals in his first seven El Clásico matches.
more: He has passed Lionel Messi's tally from his first seven meetings with Madrid.
The result tightens the title race.
stories.credit: Photo: Антон Зайцев / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0

stories.h: Davido reportedly caught on camera as a crew member mentions a $1.5m show offer at Zlatan's wedding
stories.p: A clip from Zlatan Ibile's wedding reception shows a member of Davido's crew reportedly telling him about a $1.5 million show offer, worth about ₦2 billion. His cousin, who was filming, reminded him the camera was still rolling. The video has spread widely online.
more: Davido was among the high-profile guests at the Lagos event.
Fans are debating the figure online.

stories.h: Canada-based Pastor Tayo reportedly deletes posts about Tope Alabi after a legal ultimatum
stories.p: Pastor Tayo has reportedly removed Facebook posts that linked gospel singer Tope Alabi to the death of singer Toluwanisings. Alabi's lawyers had sent a letter on 24 October demanding removal within 24 hours, a retraction and an apology, saying no investigation had linked her to the death. The posts are gone, but no apology has been reported.
more: The lawyers said the claims were baseless.
Woli Agba and Dele Omo Woli have also reportedly taken legal steps over similar claims.
stories.credit: Photo: Abiding TV / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: VeryDarkMan reportedly criticises a popular pastor over an alleged miracle
stories.p: Activist and content creator VeryDarkMan has reportedly questioned a miracle attributed to a well-known pastor, sparking debate among supporters and critics online. The pastor had not publicly responded at the time of the reports.
more: VDM is known for calling out public figures on social media.
The claims made about the miracle have not been independently verified.

stories.h: Davido's bodyguard reportedly responds when street boys interrupt the singer at an event
stories.p: A video said to show Davido's bodyguard dealing with street boys who crowded the singer at an event has drawn reactions online. Viewers were divided over how the security team handled the moment.
more: The event and date were not clearly stated in the reports.
Davido was among the celebrities who attended Zlatan Ibile's wedding at the weekend.
stories.credit: Photo: Kaizenify / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: BBNaija's Doyin David reportedly bags an international endorsement deal
stories.p: Former Big Brother Naija star Doyin David has reportedly signed an endorsement deal with an international brand. The reality star shared the news with followers, who congratulated her.
more: The value and length of the deal were not disclosed.
It adds to a run of brand deals for former housemates this year.

stories.h: Lewis Hamilton says he loves spending time with Kim Kardashian and Kanye West's children
stories.p: The Formula 1 driver reportedly spoke at a press event about the time he spends with his girlfriend's children, saying he enjoys it. His remarks drew comment from fans of both the sport and celebrity gossip.
more: Hamilton has been linked with Kardashian in recent reports.
Neither star had issued a separate statement at the time of the reports.
stories.credit: Photo: Morio / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: JPMorgan reportedly places N50 billion with the CBN as it chases a Nigerian merchant banking licence
stories.p: The US banking giant is said to have deposited N50 billion with the Central Bank, meeting the capital requirement for a merchant bank licence. Reports stress that the deposit does not guarantee approval, which the CBN must still decide. The bank is reportedly hoping to start operations by the end of 2026 or early 2027.
more: The N50 billion minimum was raised from N15 billion under the 2024 banking reforms.
Neither the CBN nor JPMorgan had publicly commented at the time of the reports.
stories.credit: Photo: Ken Lund / Flickr, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: Lere Olayinka reportedly asks DSS and police to probe viral video said to threaten Christians in Jos and Enugu
stories.p: The media aide to the FCT Minister has reportedly alerted security agencies to a video that allegedly calls for violence against Christians. He wants the clip investigated and those behind it identified. The origin and authenticity of the video have not been independently verified.
more: Security agencies had not publicly responded at the time of the report.
The call comes amid heightened political tension ahead of the 2027 elections.

stories.h: David Umahi reportedly questions why Igbos should accept only four years of the presidency
stories.p: The Works Minister is said to have reacted to Peter Obi's single-term pledge, asking why the South-East should settle for four years when others have served eight. His remarks add to the debate over Obi's plan to serve one term if elected in 2027. Supporters of the pledge argue that results matter more than tenure length.
more: Obi has said he would serve a single four-year term if elected on the NDC platform.
Igbo leaders remain divided over the idea.
stories.credit: Photo: VirtualWinnie / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: Itele explains why he defended Irewole Olaniyan amid the affair scandal
stories.p: The actor says he does not want to see the woman fall and that is why he spoke up for her. He also explained why he cautioned his wife during the row. His comments have drawn mixed reactions online.
more: Itele said he acted out of concern rather than taking sides.
Fans are split over his handling of the matter.

stories.h: Trump reportedly compliments Nicki Minaj's looks at a Michigan rally, drawing mixed reactions
stories.p: A video said to be from a Michigan rally shows the US president making a remark about the rapper's appearance. Social media users have reacted with a mix of amusement and criticism. Minaj has been a vocal supporter of Trump this year.
more: Minaj called herself his "number one fan" at an event in January.
The clip has spread widely on social media.
stories.credit: Photo: Eva Rinaldi Celebrity Photographer / Flickr, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: Ruth Kadiri says couples do not need an expensive wedding
stories.p: The Nollywood actress has spoken about the pressure lavish ceremonies place on couples. She argues that a marriage matters more than the size of the party. Her comments come days after Zlatan Ibile's star-studded wedding dominated timelines.
more: She urged couples to spend within their means.
Reactions online have been largely supportive.
stories.credit: Stock image: firemedic58 / Flickr, CC BY 2.0

stories.h: Imagine calling the police on a 3-year-old because he is too good at football!
stories.p: Parents at a children's football practice reportedly called the police because a talented 3-year-old boy was dominating the game and barely letting the other children touch the ball. According to the circulating account, the police reportedly showed up.
body: According to a circulating account, parents at a children's football practice reportedly called the police because a talented 3-year-old boy was dominating the game and barely allowing the other children to touch the ball.
Instead of speaking to the child's parents or asking the coach to encourage him to share possession and involve his teammates, they allegedly decided to involve the police.
And the saddest part? The police reportedly showed up!
We are talking about a 3-year-old child, for goodness' sake. A little boy who is simply enjoying football and showing remarkable ability at such a young age.

At that age, children are supposed to be learning, having fun, making friends and developing their talents. If one child is dominating the game, that is an opportunity for the coach to teach teamwork and fair play.
What kind of society are we creating when adults cannot resolve a simple disagreement at children's football practice without involving law enforcement?
stories.alt: Four photos of toddlers in red and blue football kits chasing a red ball on a grass pitch
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: Chioma reportedly gushes over her sister's glamorous look at Zlatan Ibile's wedding
stories.p: Davido's wife Chioma has reportedly shared her admiration for her sister's styling at Zlatan Ibile's star-studded wedding. The event continues to dominate celebrity chatter, with guests' outfits and moments still being widely discussed online.
more: Chioma is said to have praised the look in a post shared after the ceremony.
Davido's own moments at the wedding have also drawn plenty of online reaction.

stories.h: INEC reportedly sets a timeline for deciding the fate of Pantami's and Gwarzo's governorship candidacies
stories.p: INEC has reportedly indicated when Isa Ali Pantami in Gombe and Aminu Gwarzo in Kano will learn whether their governorship bids stand. Both names were missing from the commission's final list earlier this month, and their parties have disputed the omission. Pantami has also vowed to expose those he says are plotting against his bid.
more: Both names were left off the final governorship candidates list published on 10 October.
Their parties insist the two men remain their candidates in Gombe and Kano.
The governorship and presidential elections are scheduled for 6 February 2027.

stories.h: Woli Agba and Dele Omo Woli reportedly take legal action over claims linking them to Toluwanisings' death
stories.p: Gospel singer Woli Agba and Dele Omo Woli have reportedly begun legal steps over online claims that connect them to the death of singer Toluwanisings. The late singer died on 14 October, and speculation about the circumstances has been circulating since.
more: Woli Agba had earlier urged the public not to jump to conclusions while the singer was unwell.
The singer's father has also spoken publicly about his son's death.
Fans continue to pay tribute to the late gospel artiste.

stories.h: Phyna reportedly tells Nigerian hookup girls to take their work more seriously
stories.p: Big Brother Naija star Phyna has reportedly called out some women in Nigeria's hookup scene, saying they put less effort into their appearance than their counterparts abroad. Her remarks are drawing mixed reactions online.
more: Phyna says presentation matters if the work is to be treated as a serious job.
Social media users are split, with some backing her and others calling the comments harsh.

stories.h: Brazil chooses Lula again: he beats Flávio Bolsonaro to win a fourth term
stories.p: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has won Brazil's closely fought presidential runoff, defeating Senator Flávio Bolsonaro by roughly 51.8% to 48.2% after the full count, a margin of about 4.4 million votes. The victory gives Lula a fourth presidential term and completes a remarkable comeback after Bolsonaro led the first round. The result is drawing attention around the world.
more: Bolsonaro won the first round with about 47% to Lula's 45%, making Lula the first candidate since 1989 to come from behind and win a Brazilian runoff.
Voting was extended by two hours on election day, which the Bolsonaro camp may challenge in court.
Lula, now 80, begins his new term in January 2027.
stories.alt: Side-by-side portraits of Flávio Bolsonaro, left, wearing a green and yellow sash, and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, right, in a straw hat
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: "8 out of every 10 obituaries in the Southeast are men!" Woman raises alarm at Imo funeral over pressure on Igbo men
stories.p: A woman reportedly lost her cool at a funeral in Imo State, saying eight out of every ten obituaries she sees in the Southeast are of men. Her figure has not been independently verified, but her outburst has sparked a wider conversation about the pressures many men face in silence.
body: A woman reportedly lost her cool during a funeral ceremony in Imo State as she raised serious concerns about what she believes is an alarming number of men dying prematurely across Ala Igbo.

According to her, eight out of every ten obituaries she comes across in the Southeast are those of men. Although this figure has not been independently verified, her emotional outburst has raised an important conversation about the struggles many men face in silence.
She argued that financial responsibilities, marital problems, emotional stress, family expectations and the constant pressure to provide are gradually wearing many men down.

In her view, some men are carrying burdens that nobody seems interested in discussing. They are expected to pay the bills, provide for their wives and children, support extended family members and remain strong regardless of what they are going through.
She also accused some wives of making matters worse through constant domestic conflict, excessive financial demands and a lack of emotional support.

However, it would be unfair to blame women generally for men's deaths without credible evidence. Health conditions, economic hardship, lifestyle factors and access to medical care must also be considered.
But there is a serious question here that deserves attention.

When a man is struggling financially, who checks on his mental health? When he is emotionally exhausted, who listens to him? When he can no longer meet everyone's expectations, does his family support him or make him feel like a failure?
In many homes, men are expected to be strong even when everything around them is falling apart.
Marriage should be a place of peace and mutual support, not another source of unbearable pressure for either partner.
If this woman's observation reflects a wider problem, then Igbo communities need to examine the health, welfare and life expectancy of their men more seriously.
stories.alt: A woman in a black top and checked wrapper speaks into a microphone at a funeral, with other women in matching outfits standing behind her
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: Tinubu reportedly launches his APC re-election campaign with a flag-off in Kaduna
stories.p: The APC is said to have formally opened its 2027 presidential campaign in Kaduna, with President Tinubu delivering the keynote address. The full text of his speech has been circulating online. The campaign is reportedly set to move on to Port Harcourt and Maiduguri.
more: The flag-off follows the NDC and ADC unveiling their own campaign councils.
Supporters and critics have been reacting to the speech online.
The next campaign stops are reportedly Rivers and Borno states.
stories.credit: Photo: Nosa Asemota / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: NCDC says Nigeria has one confirmed Ebola case as contact tracing continues
stories.p: The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control says one confirmed Ebola case remains in the country, alongside two suspected cases. Dozens of contacts of the patient, who reportedly travelled from Uganda, have been identified and are being monitored. Authorities urge the public to rely on official updates.
more: A toll-free line, 6232, is open for reporting suspected cases.
Several states, including Zamfara, have stepped up airport and motor-park screening.
Contacts under monitoring are due weekly allowances, the agency has said.
stories.alt: Microscope image of Ebola virus particles
stories.credit: Stock image: National Institutes of Health (NIH) / Flickr, Public domain 1.0

stories.h: Tonto Dikeh's growing ministry draws attention as a prophecy video goes viral
stories.p: A viral video reportedly shows a prophet urging Tonto Dikeh to get a medical check-up, as her ministry draws growing attention online. The actress has not been reported to have responded, and reactions are split.
more: Fans have flooded the comments with prayers and questions.
Her recent move into ministry has kept her in the headlines.
stories.credit: Photo: KING TONTO DIKEH / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

stories.h: Content creator Genevieve urges Nigerians to stop voting along tribal lines
stories.p: Creator Genevieve has reportedly said tribal loyalty should not outweigh capability and good governance when Nigerians vote in 2027. Her comments, aimed at some supporters of the president, have drawn mixed reactions online.
more: Some users agreed, while others accused her of taking sides.
Ethnic and regional voting patterns are a major talking point ahead of 2027.

stories.h: Egungun of Lagos thanks Zlatan Ibile for the money that bought his first costume
stories.p: The performer known as the Egungun of Lagos has reportedly said Zlatan gave him money seven years ago to buy his first costume. He shared the message around the rapper's wedding, and fans praised the gesture.
more: Zlatan's traditional wedding has dominated entertainment chatter this weekend.
Many fans say the story shows the rapper's generosity.

stories.h: Qatar reportedly sets four conditions for foreigners seeking a company-sponsored work visa
stories.p: Qatar has reportedly announced four requirements that foreigners must meet to obtain a company-sponsored work visa. The details are drawing attention from Nigerians interested in working in the Gulf.
more: Gulf work visas remain a popular topic among young Nigerians.
stories.credit: Stock image: jikatu / Flickr, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: Daniel Bwala reportedly responds to the NDC's 2027 campaign council list
stories.p: Presidential aide Daniel Bwala has criticised the NDC's newly released campaign council, which features Peter Obi, Rabiu Kwankwaso and Governor Dickson, describing it as filled with content creators. Reports also point to disagreement within the NDC over the council list.
more: The NDC named the council earlier on Sunday.
The APC flagged off its own presidential campaign over the weekend.

stories.h: Davido and Small Doctor's interaction at Zlatan's wedding sparks online chatter
stories.p: A moment between Davido and Small Doctor at Zlatan Ibile's wedding has reportedly drawn plenty of reaction online, with fans debating what it meant.
more: The wedding has produced a string of viral moments involving Davido.
Guests included many music and Nollywood stars.

stories.h: NDC reportedly drops its Borno House of Assembly candidate
stories.p: The Nigeria Democratic Congress has reportedly removed its candidate for a House of Assembly seat in Borno State. The move is said to come as the party unveils its 2027 campaign council. No further details on the reason were immediately available.
more: The party has not been widely quoted on the decision.
It follows other disputes over candidate lists in several states.

stories.h: Fox News presenters Sean Hannity and Ainsley Earhardt reportedly marry in Florida
stories.p: Fox News presenters Sean Hannity and Ainsley Earhardt have reportedly married in Florida after a pre-wedding party said to have been attended by Donald Trump. The couple announced their engagement in late 2024.
more: The pre-wedding party was reportedly attended by the US president.
The two have long been among Fox News's best-known faces.
stories.alt: Sean Hannity speaking at an event
stories.credit: Photo: Gage Skidmore / Flickr, CC BY-SA 2.0

stories.h: Kylian Mbappe reportedly scores twice in El Clasico, shaking up Ballon d'Or talk
stories.p: Kylian Mbappe has reportedly scored two goals in El Clasico, prompting fresh updates to the Ballon d'Or rankings. Fans and pundits are debating where the goals leave him in this year's race. Ballon d'Or rankings have since been updated to reflect his form.
more: Ballon d'Or rankings have reportedly been reshuffled after the match.
Fans are debating his place in this year's race.
stories.credit: Photo: Кирилл Венедиктов / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0

stories.h: Hurzeler reportedly denies interest in the Manchester United head coach job
stories.p: Brighton boss Fabian Hurzeler has reportedly dismissed talk linking him with the Manchester United job. Reports say he is focused on his current club, while speculation continues over who could succeed Michael Carrick.
more: Several other managers are being tipped online as possible replacements.
United have not commented on the speculation.

stories.h: Rita Edochie clarifies her stance on polygamy
stories.p: Nollywood actress Rita Edochie has reportedly explained that she is not against polygamy, in comments that have drawn mixed reactions online.
more: Her remarks have been widely shared on social media.
Fans are divided over her explanation.

stories.h: Zookeeper in coma after reported leopard attack at Dutch safari park
stories.p: A zookeeper at Safaripark Beekse Bergen in the Netherlands is reportedly in a critical condition and sedated after being attacked by a leopard. The park is said to be investigating how the incident happened.
more: Emergency services were reportedly called to the scene.
The park has not given further details on the keeper's condition.

stories.h: Lady shocked at how hot solar panels on a neighbouring building became under the sun
stories.p: A lady has gone viral after showing how hot the solar panels on a three-storey building next to her house had become under the scorching sun, saying she never imagined they could generate that much heat. Solar panels can get extremely hot in direct sunlight, with surface temperatures sometimes reaching 60°C to 80°C or more in very hot weather. They are designed to turn sunlight into electricity, but they also absorb heat, and too much heat can actually reduce how well they work.
more: A panel feeling very hot does not mean it is faulty or about to catch fire; smoke, flames, a burning smell or visible damage would be the warning signs.
More Nigerians are installing rooftop solar because of the electricity situation.
But how many people really understand how these systems work?
stories.alt: Sunlight glares off solar panels on the dark roof of a cream three-storey building, seen from a neighbouring rooftop
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: APC youth leaders receive Toyota Prado SUVs for election mobilisation
stories.p: APC National Youth Leader Dayo Israel has shared a video saying he presented Toyota Prado SUVs to selected youth leaders to support the party's election mobilisation. At least seven vehicles appear in the footage, some branded with the APC logo. Israel also thanked First Lady Oluremi Tinubu for her continuing support.
more: The handover comes as parties step up campaigning ahead of the 2027 elections.
It follows earlier debate online over branded SUVs being used for the 2027 campaign.
The party has not said how many youth leaders will receive vehicles in total.
stories.alt: Black Toyota Prado SUVs, one branded "All Progressives Congress, Government House Abuja", parked on a street in Abuja
stories.credit: Image: social media

stories.h: NDC reportedly unveils its 2027 campaign council with Peter Obi, Kwankwaso and Dickson
stories.p: The Nigeria Democratic Congress has reportedly named its campaign council for the 2027 elections. The list is said to include presidential candidate Peter Obi, his running mate Rabiu Kwankwaso and party leader Seriake Dickson.
more: The announcement follows weeks of meetings in Abuja over the council's make-up.
The party had earlier dismissed reports of division over the Obi-Kwankwaso ticket.
stories.credit: Photo: Plus TV Africa / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 3.0
